beats.sub: Confirmed and adjusted detections become patterns. This is where they live.

beats.head: Learned patterns, one row each.
beats.sub: Scope, sponsor, category, confirmations and false positives. Filter by scope, origin or text.

beats.head: Patterns come from your corrections.
beats.sub: Confirm a detection with a sponsor name. A new read becomes a pattern for this podcast, a known one gets another confirmation.

beats.head: Review what it learned.
beats.sub: The text template, the intro and outro it keys on, where it came from, how often it matched and when it was wrong.

beats.head: Edit it in place.
beats.sub: Sponsor, category, the text itself, or switch it off. Split one that covers two reads.

beats.head: Near-duplicates get a merge suggestion.
beats.sub: Same sponsor, slightly different wording: one pattern that keeps the intro and outro variants.

beats.head: Pattern Cleanup, scheduled or on demand.
beats.sub: A model reads your learned patterns and proposes trims, splits, renames, retirements and flags. Experimental, off by default.

beats.head: Nothing changes until you approve.
beats.sub: Each suggestion shows before and after. Approve, reject, or undo an approval.

beats.head: The ledger keeps score.
beats.sub: Suggested, applied and reverted, and what each run cost.

beats.head: Patterns
beats.sub: Your corrections, remembered. The next episode matches them for free, before the model reads.
